newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat rises in surprisingly strong market.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat rises in surprisingly strong market.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures rose unexpectedly on Monday by A$2.00-A$3.00 a tonne.
Possibly the market had been expecting more weekend rain than had been received, Chris Gray of C,A & L Bell Commodities Corp said. Weekend rainfall was confined to scattered showers.
Market leader January 1998 was the only contract to trade, adding A$2.50 to A$197.00 on 14 lots. Sixteen January 1998 put options also sold at A$195.00 for a A$9.00 premium.
Futures settlement prices rose across the board by A$2.00-A$3.00 a tonne.
